name: Chivalric Alliance
oracle_text:
Whenever you attack with two or more creatures, draw a card.
{2}, Discard a card: Create a 2/2 white and blue Knight creature token with vigilance.
blocked_sentences: {2}, Discard a card: Create a 2/2 white and blue Knight creature token with vigilance

needs.what: a token id for a 2/2 white and blue Knight creature token with vigilance -- a two-colored (WU) 2/2 Knight with vigilance, e.g. `knight_2_2_wu_vigilance`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids is a closed list and its only Knight entries are `knight_2_2_w` (2/2 white Knight) and `knight_2_2_w_vigilance` (2/2 white Knight with vigilance). Both are mono-white, so neither is the printed token: the card prints a white AND blue Knight, and substituting the mono-white one would silently change the token's color for every card that reads colors (devotion, 'blue creatures you control', color-based protection and removal). The brief forbids approximating a token, and `create_token` takes only a `token` id -- it has no colors/keywords override in op_options -- so there is no way to spell the second color from the card.

notes: The token is the ONLY thing blocking this card -- everything else is expressible today, and the card ships the moment a one-line token id lands. The rest spells out as an Enchantment {1}{W} (colors ["W"], color_identity ["W"]) with two abilities: (1) triggered -- text "Whenever you attack with two or more creatures, draw a card.", trigger {"event": "you_attack", "controller": "you", "condition": {"cmp": ">=", "left": {"count": {"binding": "attackers"}}, "right": {"const": 2}}}, effects [{"op": "draw", "amount": {"const": 1}, "player": "you"}] -- exactly the shape champions_from_beyond uses for "Whenever you attack with four or more creatures"; (2) activated -- text "{2}, Discard a card: Create a 2/2 white and blue Knight creature token with vigilance.", cost {"mana": "{2}", "discard": 1}, effects [{"op": "create_token", "token": "<the new WU Knight id>", "amount": {"const": 1}}]. Expectation would be {"zone": "battlefield", "battlefield_count": 33} -- neither ability fires in the sandbox (no attack happens and activated abilities are never activated), so the enchantment resolving onto the battlefield is all that can be asserted.
